October 24, 2018 

Denise J. McNerney  
Merits Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States  
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC 20543-0001 

Michael B. de Leeuw 
Direct Phone  212-908-1331 
646-461-2090 
Direct Fax 
mdeleeuw@cozen.com 

Re:  Manhattan Community Access Corp. v. Halleck, No. 17-1702 

Dear Ms. McNerney:  

We represent Manhattan Community Access Corp., Petitioners in the above-referenced 
action.  We are joined in this letter by counsel for Respondents.  The Court granted our petition 
for a writ of certiorari on October 12, 2018.  Pursuant to Supreme Court Rule 25, the time for 
Petitioners to file their merits brief is currently November 26, 2018, the Monday after the 
Thanksgiving weekend.  The deadline for Respondents to file their merits brief is currently 
December 26, 2018, the day after Christmas.  We seek the clerk’s guidance as to adjusting the 
briefing schedule slightly in light of the proximity to the holidays.  Petitioners’ and Respondents’ 
counsel are amenable to a short extension of each party’s time to file a merits brief, but will 
comply with the Court’s preferred schedule in any event.   

Respectfully submitted, 

COZEN O'CONNOR 

/s/ Michael B. de Leeuw 

By:   Michael B. de Leeuw 

MBD 

cc: 

Paul Hughes, Mayer Brown LLP, Counsel for Respondents 
(by Email and Electronic Filing System) 

 45 Broadway   16th Floor New York, NY 10006 

212.509.9400     800.437.7040     212.509.9492 Fax     cozen.com

No. 17-1702 

Manhattan Community Access Corporation, et al., 

Petitioners, 

v. 

DeeDee Halleck, et al., 

Respondents. 

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE 

I hereby certify that on October 24, 2018, I served all parties required to be 

served under Rule 29.5.  Service of a copy of the foregoing letter was 
accomplished via first-class, postage-prepaid U.S. Mail, as required by U.S. 
Supreme Court Rule 29.5, on the following:  

Paul Whitfield Hughes 
Mayer Brown LLP 
1999 K Street NW 
Washington, DC 20006 

Counsel of Record for Respondents 

/s/ Michael B. de Leeuw 
Counsel for Petitioners
